response.text: Key finding: journal lines do not balance. Debits exceed credits by 27.00. I'll check which journals are out of balance, and whether the cross-ledger link and period-date fields behave as documented.

arguments.sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT") ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 20;

SELECT h."SRC_CD", h."POST_FLG", COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT h."REF_JRNL_NO") AS refs, MIN(h."POST_DT") AS min_pdt, MAX(h."POST_DT") AS max_pdt, SUM(CASE WHEN h."POST_DT" < 20240101 OR h."POST_DT" > 20241231 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_yr, SUM(CASE WHEN h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outside_period FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" GROUP BY h."SRC_CD", h."POST_FLG";
